title: CAM-54 slice 3: real CodexAdapter (codex exec spawn-argv) + per-phase adapter selection
description: CAM-54 slice-3 (per ADR-0046/0047 slice sequence; slice-2 shipped as CAM-349). Add the second BackendAdapter implementation so the OpenAI codex CLI (v0.144.6, `codex exec`) can be a worker backend selectable per-phase alongside claude. Grounded against the real installed codex CLI; the six ADR-0047 mismatches resolve as: F2 completion (codex agent writes worker-report.json + prints CAM_*_STATUS sentinel via injected instructions, identical uniform contract, no read-side branch); F4 agent-prompt (no --agent flag; strip frontmatter from .claude/agents/<name>.md per spawn, write body to a temp file, pass -c model_instructions_file=<tmp>); F5 sandbox/env (--sandbox {read-only|workspace-write|danger-full-access}, --ask-for-approval never, --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox; codex has NO CLAUDECODE-style nesting guard so no recursion env-strip needed; auth via OPENAI_API_KEY/CODEX_API_KEY); F6 session (codex cannot take a caller-minted --session-id, but the uuid was never load-bearing for completion which is file+pane based, so CodexAdapter ignores the input uuid; post-hoc session correlation deferred to slice-4); F3 token-ceiling (usage.ts is claude .jsonl shaped; codex backend logs token-ceiling-unavailable and skips the backstop, a real codex usage parser is a separate future slice); F1 wiring (add selectAdapter(backend) factory and wire the four dispatch call sites in loop.ts/review.ts/plan-runner.ts to pick ClaudeAdapter vs CodexAdapter via readPhaseBackend, which is currently a dead-end event-only value). Deliverable: CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv for all four WorkerActors, the selection factory, graceful token-ceiling degradation for the codex backend, and argv-shape plus back-compat tests (claude argv byte-identical, no live run). A real mixed-backend live dispatch is slice-4, out of scope here. Orchestrator-persona, retry-launcher, and auth-preflight codex parity stay deferred (slice-6).
